title: Tech pack review
description: We check construction, measurements and fabric spec, then return a costing and open questions.

title: Sampling
description: Proto, fit and pre-production samples from our in-house sample room. Fabric sourced from approved mills.

title: Bulk production
description: Allocated to the partner factory best suited to the product. Weekly progress photos and line reports.

title: Inspection
description: Inline and final inspection to AQL 1.0 or 2.5. Third-party inspection welcome.

title: Packing & shipping
description: Packed to your carton and labelling spec. FOB Hai Phong or door-to-door via forwarder.
duration: Sea 25–35 days to US West Coast
